newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates firm after operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates firm after operation.

text.p: Pakistani overnight rates firmed on Wednesday after the central bank picked up some 8.6 billion rupees at an average annualised yield of 14.9 percent in its weekly open market operation, dealers said.
Rates jumped to 17.5 percent after the operation from eight percent in the morning, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. Discounting of some 900 million rupees was also reported.
The rates are likely to stay firm on Thursday, the dealer said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
